newsitem.title: DUBAI: SAA, Emirates in second Dubai-Jo'burg code share.
newsitem.headline: SAA, Emirates in second Dubai-Jo'burg code share.

text.p: South African Airways and Emirates airline will operate a second weekly code-sharing flight between Dubai and Johannesburg from October 27, SAA Middle East and Gulf manager Vees Lochan said on Thursday.
The direct flight will be operated on an Emirates A310 Airbus.
"It is in keeping with the growth in the route in terms of passengers as we go into the peak season," Lochan said.
He said like the airlines' other code-sharing agreement, this one does not cover cargo. "But we are going to try to work towards total code share on all our flights," he said.
The new flight will leave Dubai at 0440 local time on Sundays, arriving at 1110 in Johannesburg, and return at 0915., arriving in Dubai on Mondays at 0525.
SAA operates two weekly services between Dubai and Johannesburg, one of which is via Bombay. Last December it started operating a once-weekly joint flight with Emirates.
Emirates operates a twice-weekly service to Johannesburg via the Comoro islands.
